items.title: IndiGo's next growth phase: Rahul Bhatia says airline chasing customer preference, not just market share
items.description: After dominating India's skies through rapid expansion, IndiGo is repositioning itself as a premium airline, betting on better customer experience and service quality to power its next phase of growth

items.title: How railway's dedicated freight corridors are redrawing India's truck-demand map
items.description: Dedicated freight corridors are expected to redistribute demand in commercial vehicle segments, giving boost to last-mile and mining trucks even as a part of long-haul cargo shifts from highways to rail

items.title: IndiGo appoints Kiran Thadimarri as new CFO, replacing Gaurav Negi
items.description: IndiGo, India's largest airline, appointed Kiran Thadimarri as its finance chief on Monday, replacing Gaurav Negi, it said in a statement

items.title: Porsche to shed 5,000 jobs by 2035 under German factory pact
items.description: VW has a number of underused factories, is saddled with costs roughly 30% higher than some competitors and needs to trim at least €10 billion ($11.4 billion) more in overhead expenses.

items.title: Tata Motors' Sanand plant faces production disruption after heavy rains
items.description: Tata Motors' Sanand plant manufactures the Tiago, Tigor, Nexon and Sierra models. The company said efforts are underway to restore operations and production is expected to resume over the next few days.

items.title: BEL to announce indigenisation policy, targets zero module imports in five years: CMD Manoj Jain
items.description: The company plans to replace imported RF (radio frequency), microwave, computing and other subsystem modules with indigenous alternatives

items.title: Marlboro cigarette maker Godfrey Phillips quarterly profit drops on tobacco tax
items.description: Cigarette maker Godfrey Phillips reported a 44% rise in first quarter profit. Consolidated net profit fell to Rs 198 crore ($20.64 million) from Rs 356 crore last year.

items.title: Zepto, investors test waters with revised post-money IPO valuation of around $3 billion
items.description: Zepto received the Sebi nod for its IPO in April and commanded a valuation of $7 billion during its last capital raise in October 2025

items.title: IndiGo Dubai-Mumbai flight diverted to Rajkot after smoke detected in cargo hold
items.description: The flight, IGO 1452, was carrying 194 passengers and crew members. Airport authorities said the aircraft landed safely and all those on board were evacuated without any injuries.

items.title: 'Every great airline was built over decades, not quarters': Chandrasekaran backs Air India despite mounting losses
items.description: The Tata Sons chairman said Air India's transformation should be viewed as a five-to-ten-year journey, arguing that rebuilding a global airline cannot be measured by quarterly financial performance

items.title: Shriram Finance delivers strong Q1 as margins expand, capital strengthens
items.description: Stronger execution and higher profitability could drive valuation re-rating

items.title: Tata Consumer Q1 FY27: Bottom line beat backed by growth businesses
items.description: Earnings driven by growth engines, supported by healthy core growth and margin expansion

items.title: Air India modifying certain Boeing 787 Dreamliners after FAA issues safety directive on door handles
items.description: Air India currently operates a fleet of 35 Boeing 787 Dreamliners, including 26 legacy Boeing 787-8 aircraft and nine Boeing 787-9 aircraft.

items.title: India among top five growth markets, centre of global strategy for Red Hat
items.description: Addressing concerns regarding AI-induced job losses in the IT sector, Bal stated that while the technology will unlock efficiency gains of 2-5 per cent year-on-year, India’s high economic growth rate is likely to offset potential employment risks

items.title: NTPC board approves raising up to Rs 12,000 crore via NCD issue
items.description: The Board of Directors of the company, at its meeting held on Friday, July 24, 2026, approved the issue of non-convertible debentures up to Rs 12,000 crore

items.title: BNP Paribas Cardif seals buyout of 26% stake in IndiaFirst Life from Warburg Pincus
items.description: On September 16, Moneycontrol was the first to report that Warburg Pincus had appointed investment bank Barclays to kickstart the exit process.

items.title: SAIL Q1 net profit more than doubles to Rs 1,644 cr
items.description: It had reported a net profit of Rs 744.58 crore in the year-ago quarter, the company said in an exchange filing.

items.title: NTPC net profit up nearly 13% to Rs 6,897 crore in Q1
items.description: The consolidated net profit was Rs 6,108.46 crore in the quarter ended on June 30, 2025, an exchange filing stated.

items.title: 'Switch off, switch on': Skyroot CEO reveals Indian fix that saved historic rocket launch
items.description: Pavan Kumar Chandana said the issue that delayed Skyroot's maiden launch was ultimately resolved with the most basic troubleshooting step

items.title: Kalind Ltd to raise Rs 627 crore to expand fleet, acquire machinery
items.description: The company has announced a 1:5 stock split and a 1:2 bonus issue, for which the record date to determine the shareholders' eligibility was July 24, 2026.

items.title: Ather flags 'policy quirk' in Auto PLI, says EV startups miss out on 16% incentive despite driving investments
items.description: Ather Energy CEO Tarun Mehta said a technical anomaly in the Automotive PLI scheme has denied EV startups incentives, even as they drive manufacturing investments, capacity expansion and innovation

items.title: Adani Energy Solutions wins Rs 8,500-crore transmission project in Andhra Pradesh for green hydrogen, ammonia project
items.description: The project, awarded through the Government of India's Tariff-Based Competitive Bidding (TBCB) framework will support the growing power requirement in the Pendurthi-Vizag region, where a new wave of data centre and digital infrastructure investments is taking shape.

items.title: Sterlite Tech's Q1 profit jumps to record Rs 197 crore; revenue rises 87%
items.description: The performance comes as hyperscalers and telecom operators accelerate investments in AI infrastructure, driving demand for high-capacity optical connectivity solutions and next-generation data centres.

items.title: Diet Coke gets costlier in India as Coca-Cola hikes prices by over 10%
items.description: Diet Coke is getting pricier. Unlike most other markets, the fizzy drink is sold mostly in cans in India, making it more vulnerable to disruptions.

items.title: Canada's Enervoxa plans India rare earths project, may tie up with Vedanta, NALCO
items.description: India holds substantial rare earth reserves but lacks industrial-scale facilities capable of processing the minerals to high purity levels. Canada Enervoxa to hold talks with Vedanta to set up processing plant to extract rare earths from waste byproduct of aluminium production.
